entities.title: Double Cross
entities.summary: A spy-trap party game in Godot 4 for the browser: up to eight agents search furniture for intel, rig furniture and doorways with traps, and race to the extraction door; the eliminated keep watching every survivor in spectator mode.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Godot project in godot/, the page's boot script in boot/, the Worker that serves the build in worker/, and the tests in test/ and godot/tests/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: Online matches are made on icelander.net's multiplayer page and relayed by the games hub, which lives in another repository; this folder only connects to the relay.
The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
